import ast,hashlib,importlib.util,io,json,sys,unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
ROOT=Path.cwd();OUT=ROOT/'outputs/runtime-hardening-20261116';OLD=OUT/'prior-code'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('prior_writing_fixture', OLD/'tests/test_memory_writing.py')
fixture=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(fixture)
from agent_memory_eval.memory import writing
from agent_memory_eval.recording.provenance import SourceRegistry
assert str(OLD/'src') in writing.__file__
names=['test_writer_reasoning_is_preserved_raw_but_not_reintroduced_as_history','test_audit_refuses_extra_context_even_with_valid_provenance','test_duplicate_writer_id_is_refused_before_creating_another_bank','test_audit_refuses_cost_that_differs_from_the_raw_response']
parsed=ast.parse((ROOT/'tests/test_memory_writing.py').read_text())
source_class=next(node for node in parsed.body if isinstance(node,ast.ClassDef) and node.name=='MemoryWritingTests')
methods=[node for node in source_class.body if isinstance(node,ast.FunctionDef) and node.name in names]
namespace=dict(fixture.__dict__,patch=patch,SourceRegistry=SourceRegistry)
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=methods,type_ignores=[]),'<current-regression-methods>','exec'),namespace)
class PriorRegressions(fixture.MemoryWritingTests):pass
for name in names:setattr(PriorRegressions,name,namespace[name])
log=io.StringIO();result=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=log).run(unittest.TestSuite(PriorRegressions(name) for name in names))
assert result.testsRun==4 and len(result.failures)==4 and not result.errors,log.getvalue()
(OUT/'prior-failures.log').write_text(log.getvalue())
report=dict(status='expected_failures_reproduced',baseline_commit='1e59371',tests_run=result.testsRun,failures=len(result.failures),errors=len(result.errors),failed_tests=names,
 prior_writing_source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(writing.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 method_source=ast.unparse(ast.Module(body=methods,type_ignores=[])),new_model_or_catalog_calls=0)
(OUT/'prior-failures.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in report.items() if k!='method_source'}))
